title: Projects
description: Here is a curated catalog of high-fidelity UI/UX design case studies and SaaS engineering deployments.

items.title: Loan Rule Engine
items.description: Multi-tenant BRE–CRE platform automating loan evaluations from sequential document upload to bank recommendation using Rust parsing and FastAPI rule processing.

items.title: Reconciliation Platform
items.description: Scalable financial reconciliation platform with microservices, asynchronous Kafka processing, CQRS/event-sourcing, and a Rust comparison engine for Excel documents.

items.title: Goyaz Jewellery
items.description: Conversion-optimized, story-led premium silver jewellery commerce system. Redesigned browsing paths, PDP trust signals, and interactive checkout to align narrative with purchase intent.

items.title: Sturdy Studio
items.description: Avant-garde, dual-brand fashion e-commerce strategy. Implemented dual-theme token mappings, low-latency client-side caching, and progressive disclosure for high-consideration purchases.

items.title: Tarun CMA
items.description: Strategy-driven UI/UX design for a major chartered accounting firm. Transformed tax and compliance complexities into highly-structured, credible conversion tunnels for founders.

items.title: Mallikarjuna CMA
items.description: Corporate audit and advisory platform. Resolved high Core Web Vitals layout shifts, unified service registries, and structured user journeys for NRI and enterprise clients.

items.title: Show Off Salon
items.description: Luxury salon appointment booking funnel. Unified conflicting scheduling calendars, stabilized location metadata, and designed high-fidelity consultation pipelines.

items.title: Multi-Tenant HR Product
items.description: Designed and built a scalable HRMS with dynamic URN-based routing and UUID-driven data isolation, supporting secure multi-tenant workflows and high-performance operations.

items.title: CAD Doctor
items.description: Cost-effective 2D CAD drawing management and comparison platform built with Rust-based PDF parsing, URN-based dynamic routing, and multi-tenant project organization.

items.title: HW-OCR Deposit Form
items.description: Designed and implemented a high-accuracy handwritten OCR system for bank deposit forms by integrating computer vision, object detection, and transformer-based OCR models.

items.title: Insurance Product
items.description: Built a secure insurance platform featuring policy management, claims processing, role-based access, chatbot assistance, and online payments with real-time transaction tracking.

items.title: Blog Publishing Platform
items.description: Created a full-featured content platform with authentication, rich text editing, nested comments, moderation tools, and scalable deployment on AWS.

items.title: CMA Firm Website
items.description: Designed and developed a modern, strategy-driven corporate website for a CMA firm, translating complex financial services into a clear, trust-focused digital experience using Figma, MCP servers, and Next.js.
